title: elatostema heyneanum
intro: Elatostema heyneanum, commonly known as the "Indian Cucumber Tree," is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion. The therapeutic actions of Elatostema heyneanum include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as arthritis and wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
